Application Data.NAME: CleanSweep Solutions, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: CleanSweep Solutions, Inc. provides a range of janitorial and cleaning services to commercial and institutional clients, including office buildings, schools, and healthcare facilities. Our operations involve routine floor care, restroom sanitation, and general cleaning using environmentally friendly cleaning agents. We prioritize employee training and utilize background checks and safety protocols to minimize risks related to employee dishonesty and chemical handling. Our fleet of properly maintained vehicles is used solely for transportation of staff and cleaning supplies, ensuring compliance with commercial auto requirements. We have implemented quality control procedures to maintain high standards of cleanliness and safety while minimizing potential pollution risks from our cleaning agents.
